notes: Port list is cross-confirmed across three independent secondary sources that all appear to quote Promethean's own spec sheet table (Connection.com/GovConnection product listing, and a Medium article reproducing the datasheet), but I could not directly load the official Promethean PDF (prometheanworld.com blocked WebFetch/curl with 403) or the Promethean support KB article (returned only a loading-error shell) to confirm firsthand. Treat HDMI/DisplayPort/USB versions and counts as reliable (matched verbatim across sources) but not first-party-verified. "AV-In (3.5mm)" is listed in sources as a 3.5mm jack; this is likely a proprietary breakout (composite/component via minijack) rather than a true audio-only 3.5mm line and is mapped here to trs-3.5 as the closest connector id — could not confirm exact pin function. RS-232 connector is confirmed as DSUB 9-pin male from a separate Promethean support article (control codes page), mapped to rs232. Power inlet connector type (IEC vs NEMA captive cord) was not explicitly stated in any source for the NA variant; mapped to "iec" as the closest/most common for this panel class but this is an inference, not confirmed — flagging as a caveat. OPS slot (Open Pluggable Specification bay for a Windows compute module) is a card-edge/OPS interface, not in the provided connector enum, so it is omitted from the ports list rather than mis-mapped. NFC and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth radios are omitted (not physical wired ports). MicroSD slot omitted (not in connector enum and not a signal/power port in the AV sense). Rear USB-A 2.0 (1x) and USB-A 3.0 (2 front + 2 rear) are listed separately per source; USB-B 3.0 touch ports (1 front + 3 rear) are for touch/OPS pass-through, not general host USB - graded as usb-5g (USB 3.0/3.2 Gen1 = 5Gbps) per convention. USB-C is described as "USB-C 3.2" with 100W Power Delivery - graded as usb-5g (3.2 Gen1 nomenclature typically denotes 5Gbps on this class of interactive panel; could not confirm Gen2/10Gbps from sources, so conservative grade chosen). EU variant (AP9-B75-EU-1) has a different plug/voltage standard but same port architecture; NA unit specified here.
